IDENTICAL -> RECALL_RERUN_NOT_DISCRIMINATING and the benchmark is NOT re-executed (documented negative result: the defect's causal bytes are unchanged, so a re-run could only reproduce 40261335674 and its unaccepted sibling 46086820588).
